items.scope: Vulnerabilities in Intigriti products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Intigriti that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
JetBrains products only.
Digi branded products and services only.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Hitachi Energy products only.
All Netskope products and services.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
ABB issues only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
AMD branded products and technologies only.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Third-party products it researches.
Lexmark products only.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Hanwha Vision (formerly Samsung Techwin and Hanwha Techwin) products and solutions only, including end-of-life (EOL).
Vulnerabilities discovered by Project Black that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SBA Research or reported to SBA Research by partner organizations that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Forcepoint products only.
Jamf issues and Jamf Open Source.
Palantir products and technologies only.
openHarmony issues only.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
All Honeywell products.
Microchip Technology products only.
Adobe issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
Radiometer products only.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.

All Ping Identity and ForgeRock products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Ping Identity or ForgeRock that are not in another CNA’s scope.
